note: A SITE, placed: one place on the base that builds terrain, whose piece owns its ground (`base: {"owned": 3}`, spec-0106 §3.1). `gallery-bank` is three courses of island mass, a bank of grass out to the box's own edge and a walled court on top; the whole's flat terrain meets its bottom course from below (`DW1021` when it does not, `the-valley-lowered-under-the-bank`), and its allocation fixes no ring cell — the piece draws its own ground (`DW0990` when it is declared `ground` instead, `the-bank-on-the-ground`). It carries both halves of `DW0885` at once — the courses under the bank buried by earth, the parapet above it answered by four `shown_faces` — and its own cast and quest layer, whose guidance is quiet with its far corner opting its marker back in.
